svg.title: Transformer layer, in motion
svg.desc: An animation of one transformer layer, GPT-2 sizes, on the text “The cat sat on the mat because it”, following the token “it”. 1, input: the 8 tokens become 8 columns of 768 numbers each, the input matrix. 2, multi-head causal self-attention: “it” looks back at every earlier word (never ahead). Its query is compared with each word’s key to give a score, and softmax turns the scores into weights that add up to 1: cat 0.62, mat 0.14, because 0.07, it 0.05, sat 0.04, The 0.03, the 0.03, on 0.02. The new “it” is the weighted mix of the words’ values, mostly “cat”. 12 heads do this in parallel, each looking for something different (head 1: who is “it”, cat; head 2: where, mat), 64 numbers each, joined back into 768. The result is added back to the main line. 3, MLP, drawn as an hourglass: “it”’s 768 numbers fan out into 3,072 detectors, 4 times wider; some detectors fire and are kept, the others stay off and are set to 0; only the firing ones feed back into 768 numbers, an update that is added back again. 4, out: 8 tokens by 768 numbers, the same shape as the input; “it” now carries “the cat”. GPT-2 repeats this layer 12 times. Weights are illustrative.
svg.text: Input: “The cat sat on the mat because it”. Follow “it”. Sizes are GPT-2’s.

g.text: 8 tokens × 768 numbers each (d = 768): the input matrix
New “it” = 0.62 × cat + 0.14 × mat + 0.07 × because + … (a weighted mix of the words’ values)
Causal: “it” looks only back. Words after it aren’t written yet.
add back to the main line (residual)
add back to the main line (residual)
4 · OUT: 8 tokens × 768 numbers, the same shape as the input. “it” now carries “the cat”.
